### `CYLBadgeView/CYLBadgeAppearance.h`

| iOS 公开 API / iOS public API | 接口注释 / Comment | 鸿蒙对应接口 / HarmonyOS API |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `CYLBadgeAppearance` | App-wide default badge style. Most apps use the same badge everywhere (a red background, white text, one font, the same corner offset), but each badge property belongs to one object, so it had to be set on every tab, bar button and view again. Set the defaults here once, typically in `-application:didFinishLaunchingWithOptions:`, before showing badges: CYLBadgeAppearance *appearance = [CYLBadgeAppearance globalAppearance]; appearance.backgroundColor = [UIColor systemPinkColor]; appearance.font = [UIFont boldSystemFontOfSize:10]; appearance.centerOffset = CGPointMake(-2, 2); Precedence: a value set on an object (e.g. `viewController.cyl_badgeBackgroundColor`) wins over the global one; the global one wins over the built-in default. This covers every badge host: UIViewController, UITabBarItem, UIBarButtonItem, UIControl and UIView. Badges created later use the new defaults. A badge already on screen picks up new colors, font and border the next time it is shown (`-cyl_showBadgeValue:animationType:`); a red dot keeps its size and position until its style changes. So set the appearance before showing badges. Use it on the main thread, like the rest of UIKit. | `CYLBadgeAppearance` (built; emulator check pending / 已编译，模拟器验证待做) |
| `CYLBadgeAppearance globalAppearance` | The shared global appearance. In Swift: `CYLBadgeAppearance.global`. | `CYLBadgeAppearance.globalAppearance` (built; emulator check pending / 已编译，模拟器验证待做) |
| `CYLBadgeAppearance backgroundColor` | Background color. Red by default; set nil to restore it. Dynamic colors follow Dark Mode. | `CYLBadgeAppearance.backgroundColor` (built; emulator check pending / 已编译，模拟器验证待做) |
| `CYLBadgeAppearance textColor` | Text color. White by default; set nil to restore it. | `CYLBadgeAppearance.textColor` (built; emulator check pending / 已编译，模拟器验证待做) |
| `CYLBadgeAppearance font` | Text font. `[UIFont boldSystemFontOfSize:9]` by default; set nil to restore it. | `CYLBadgeAppearance.fontSize` (built; emulator check pending / 已编译，模拟器验证待做) |
| `CYLBadgeAppearance centerOffset` | Offset of the badge center from the host's top-right corner, {0, 0} by default. Positive x moves it right, positive y moves it down. Non-finite values are treated as 0. | `CYLBadgeAppearance.centerOffset` (built; emulator check pending / 已编译，模拟器验证待做) |
| `CYLBadgeAppearance radius` | Radius of the red dot (`cyl_showBadge`, or a value of @""), 4 by default. 0, negative or non-finite values restore the default. | `CYLBadgeAppearance.radius` (built; emulator check pending / 已编译，模拟器验证待做) |

| `CYLFlatDesignTabBar 0` | The `UITabBarAppearance` of the flat design tab bar, like `-[UITabBar standardAppearance]`: one appearance object styles the system tab bar (Liquid Glass and the classic style) and this tab bar alike. Nil (the default) keeps the flat design look and the properties below. `CYLTabBarController` assigns `tabBarController.tabBar.standardAppearance` here when the app has set one, so setting the system tab bar's appearance is enough; assigning this property directly also works. When the selected item has its own `-[CYLFlatDesignTabBarItem standardAppearance]`, the whole bar uses that one while it is selected, as `UITabBar` does. Mapping (UITabBarAppearance → flat design tab bar): backgroundEffect → the background blur (nil: no blur) backgroundColor → the background color backgroundImage → the background image backgroundImageContentMode → the background image's content mode shadowImage → the top shadow line (its own height; tinted by shadowColor if template) shadowColor → a hairline at the top when there is no shadowImage (nil/clear: none) selectionIndicatorImage → drawn behind the selected item selectionIndicatorTintColor → tints the selection indicator image stackedItemPositioning → .centered lays the items out centered; .fill / .automatic fill the width stackedItemWidth → the item width when centered (0: equal share of the width) stackedItemSpacing → the spacing between items when centered stackedLayoutAppearance.normal / .selected / .disabled (UITabBarItemStateAppearance): titleTextAttributes → title font, color and other attributes (they override the item's own) titlePositionAdjustment → the title offset when the item has none (`CYLTabBarController.titlePositionAdjustment` wins, as on the system tab bar) iconColor → the icon tint color (template images) badgeBackgroundColor → the badge background color badgeTextAttributes → the badge font and text color badgePositionAdjustment → the badge center offset Not mapped: inline/compact inline layouts (the flat design bar is always stacked), scroll edge appearances, `badgeTitlePositionAdjustment` and the focused state. Badge values a state does not customize (equal to a new `UITabBarAppearance`) leave the badge's own settings and `CYLBadgeAppearance` in place. | N/A on HarmonyOS: no UITabBarAppearance; the same `CYLTabBarController` props (tintColor, barTintColor, tabBarBackgroundColor…) style every `tabBarStyleType` / 不适用：没有 UITabBarAppearance；同一组 `CYLTabBarController` 属性为所有 `tabBarStyleType` 设置样式 |

For a custom shadow to be shown, a custom background image must also be set with -setBackgroundImage: (if the default background image is used, the default shadow image will be used). | `CYLTabBarController.shadowImage` (drawn as the top line instead of the 0.5 vp shadow color) (built; emulator check pending / 已编译，模拟器验证待做) |

The one-sided inset of a vertical status bar (the folded iPhone Duo's right-hand status column) is controlled separately by `respectsVerticalStatusBarSafeArea` (ignored by default). | TODO: the bar only extends into the bottom safe area; buttons do not avoid a left / right cutout in landscape / 待做：TabBar 只扩展到底部安全区；横屏时按钮不避开左右挖孔 |
| `CYLFlatDesignTabBar respectsVerticalStatusBarSafeArea` | Default is NO. Whether the buttons also stay clear of the inset that a vertical status bar adds on one side, e.g. the 84 pt column on the right of the folded iPhone Duo held upright (iOS 27.1 SDK), where the status bar (Wi-Fi, battery) moves to the trailing edge. NO: that one-sided inset is ignored, so the buttons span the full width and stay centered on screen; the last button can sit partly under the status column. YES: the buttons stay inside the safe area, so the row is shifted left by that column. A vertical status bar is told apart by its inset being on one side only; a landscape notch insets both sides and is still handled by `useLayoutSafeAreaInsets`. Has no effect when `useLayoutSafeAreaInsets` is NO. Only matters while the vertical bar is shown. This property does not switch the vertical bar on or off; that is `CYLTabBarController.allowsVerticalBar` (or a screen's own `preferredVerticalBarBehavior`). With the vertical bar off the status bar is horizontal, there is no one-sided inset, and both values give the same layout. | N/A on HarmonyOS: iPhone Duo vertical status bar column; HarmonyOS has no such one-sided status bar inset / 不适用：iPhone Duo 的竖向状态栏列；鸿蒙没有这种单侧状态栏边距 |
| `CYLFlatDesignTabBar context` | This can be left unset; the default is CYLTabBarController. | `CYLTabBarDidLayoutSubViewsBlock` | — | N/A on HarmonyOS: UIKit layoutSubviews hook; ArkUI tab buttons are not exposed for post-layout changes / 不适用：UIKit layoutSubviews 回调；ArkUI 的 Tab 按钮不对外暴露，无法在布局后修改 |
| `CYLTabBar` | Returns the owning CYLTabBarController (the delegate if it is one, otherwise `cyl_tabBarController`). | `CYLTabBarController` (its tab bar) (built; emulator check pending / 已编译，模拟器验证待做) |
| `CYLTabBar tabImageViewDefaultOffset` | The default offset needed to vertically center the `TabImageView`. @attention This value is used for both top and bottom; the operation is equivalent to the following: `viewController.tabBarItem.imageInsets = UIEdgeInsetsMake(tabImageViewDefaultOffset, 0, -tabImageViewDefaultOffset, 0);` | N/A on HarmonyOS: UIKit image inset needed to center a UITabBarButton image; ArkUI centers it (`CYLTabBarItemAttributes.layoutCentered` / `imageInsets`) / 不适用：让 UITabBarButton 图片居中所需的 UIKit 偏移；ArkUI 自己居中（`layoutCentered` / `imageInsets`） |
| `CYLTabBar syncsClassicStylesToAppearance` | Since iOS 13 UIKit ignores the classic styles (`tintColor`, `barTintColor`, `unselectedItemTintColor`, `backgroundImage`, `shadowImage`, `barStyle`) once the tab bar uses `UITabBarAppearance`. When YES (default), each classic setter also writes its value into `standardAppearance` (and `scrollEdgeAppearance` when there is one), so both ways of styling work together; only a value that changed is written. Not with Liquid Glass, where the system draws the bar. Set NO to keep UIKit's own behavior. | N/A on HarmonyOS: UIKit split between classic styles and UITabBarAppearance; ArkUI has one set of `CYLTabBarController` props / 不适用：UIKit 经典样式与 UITabBarAppearance 的分裂；ArkUI 只有一套 `CYLTabBarController` 属性 |
| `CYLTabBar context` | This can be left unset; the default is CYLTabBarController. If set, please implement the `+[CYLPlusButton tabBarContext]` method in CYLPlusButton and ensure consistency. If neither is implemented, the default is CYLTabBarController for both. | N/A on HarmonyOS: no global plus button registry keyed by tab bar context; each CYLTabBarController instance takes its own `plusButton` (@Prop) / 不适用：没有按 tab bar context 区分的全局加号按钮注册表；每个 CYLTabBarController 实例通过自己的 `plusButton`（@Prop）配置 |

| `CYLTabBar cyl_itemEdgeInsets` | Space kept free at the two ends of the classic tab bar: the tab buttons (and the plus button) are laid out between `left` (the leading end, mirrored in right-to-left layouts) and `right` (the trailing end); `top` and `bottom` are not used. Default `UIEdgeInsetsZero` (the layout is exactly as before). Works with and without a plus button, and together with centered positioning (docs/Tab-Item-Positioning.md). Liquid Glass and FlatDesign are not affected. ### `CYLTabBarConfigurationParser.h`

| iOS 公开 API / iOS public API | 接口注释 / Comment | 鸿蒙对应接口 / HarmonyOS API |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `CYLTabBarConfigurationFormat` | The key-value file formats a tab bar configuration can be written in (see `-[CYLTabBarController initWithConfiguration:]`). Every format gives the same dictionary: its keys are the configuration and item keys (`CYLTabBarControllerContext`, `CYLTabBarItemTitle`, ...). | `CYLTabBarConfigurationFormat` (built; emulator check pending / 已编译，模拟器验证待做) |
| `CYLTabBarConfigurationErrorDomain` | Error domain of the configuration parser and loaders. | `CYLTabBarConfigurationErrorDomain` (built; emulator check pending / 已编译，模拟器验证待做) |
| `CYLTabBarConfigurationErrorCode` | — | `CYLTabBarConfigurationErrorCode` (built; emulator check pending / 已编译，模拟器验证待做) |
| `CYLTabBarConfigurationMaximumLength` | The largest file or response read: 5 MB. | `CYLTabBarConfigurationMaximumLength` (built; emulator check pending / 已编译，模拟器验证待做) |
| `CYLTabBarConfigurationMaximumDepth` | The deepest nesting accepted: 64 levels, far more than a configuration needs, far less than overflows the stack. | `CYLTabBarConfigurationMaximumDepth` (built; emulator check pending / 已编译，模拟器验证待做) |
| `CYLTabBarConfigurationParser` | Reads key-value configuration files into dictionaries, in every `CYLTabBarConfigurationFormat`. Foundation only, no UIKit: the values stay strings, numbers, booleans, arrays and dictionaries; `CYLTabBarController` turns them into insets, offsets, sizes, URLs and images (see `-[CYLTabBarController initWithConfiguration:]`). Binary Protocol Buffers use the built-in schema of Configurations/cyl_tabbar_configuration.proto. Text formats are read as UTF-8. YAML, TOML, INI, .properties and XML give unquoted `true` / `false` as booleans and numbers as NSNumber; YAML and TOML support the common subset used for configuration (no anchors, tags or multi-line block scalars in YAML; no dates in TOML). | `CYLTabBarConfigurationParser` (built; emulator check pending / 已编译，模拟器验证待做) |
| `CYLTabBarConfigurationParser +supportedPathExtensions` | — | TODO: `CYLTabBarConfigurationParser` has no list of supported path extensions (only JSON / JSON5 / JSONC are parsed) / 待做：`CYLTabBarConfigurationParser` 没有支持的扩展名列表（目前只解析 JSON / JSON5 / JSONC） |
| `CYLTabBarConfigurationParser +formatForPathExtension:` | — | `CYLTabBarConfigurationParser.formatForPathExtension()` (built; emulator check pending / 已编译，模拟器验证待做) |
| `CYLTabBarConfigurationParser +formatForMIMEType:` | — | `CYLTabBarConfigurationParser.formatForMIMEType()` (built; emulator check pending / 已编译，模拟器验证待做) |

| `CYLTabBarConfigurationParser +nameOfFormat:` | — | TODO: no display name for a `CYLTabBarConfigurationFormat` value / 待做：没有 `CYLTabBarConfigurationFormat` 的显示名称函数 |
| `CYLTabBarConfigurationParser +dictionaryWithData:format:error:` | — | `CYLTabBarConfigurationParser.configurationWithString(text, format)` — JSON, JSON5 / JSONC so far (built; emulator check pending / 已编译，模拟器验证待做) |

### `CYLTabBarController.h`

| iOS 公开 API / iOS public API | 接口注释 / Comment | 鸿蒙对应接口 / HarmonyOS API |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `CYLViewDidLayoutSubViewsBlock` | Sets the block invoked in `-viewDidLayoutSubviews`. | N/A on HarmonyOS: ArkUI has no -viewDidLayoutSubviews; an app reacts to layout with `onAreaChange` / `onSizeChange` on its own component / 不适用：ArkUI 没有 -viewDidLayoutSubviews；App 在自己的组件上用 `onAreaChange` / `onSizeChange` 响应布局 |
| `CYLTabBarItemTitle` | Optional per-tab colors (UIColor), in `tabBarItemsAttributes` (or `-updateTabBarItemAtIndex:attributes:`). See docs/Tab-Item-Colors.md. - `CYLTabBarItemTitleColor` / `CYLTabBarItemSelectedTitleColor`: the title color, unselected / selected. - `CYLTabBarItemIconColor` / `CYLTabBarItemSelectedIconColor`: the icon tint, unselected / selected. Only template images are tinted (`UIImageRenderingModeAlwaysTemplate`, SF Symbols); image names are drawn as original. - `CYLTabBarItemSelectedBackgroundColor`: fills the selected tab (classic tab bar and FlatDesign; Liquid Glass draws its own selection). Title and icon colors need iOS 13+ (`UITabBarAppearance`) and are ignored on iOS 12. Classic and Liquid Glass: the colors are written into the tab's own `UITabBarItem.standardAppearance` (and `scrollEdgeAppearance` on iOS 15+), a copy of the tab bar's appearance that is rebuilt when that one changes, as for `CYLTabBarItemTitlePositionAdjustment`; an appearance you installed on the item is kept as the base. FlatDesign: the flat item's title attributes and `selectedBackgroundColor`. | `CYLTabBarItemAttributes.title` (built; emulator check pending / 已编译，模拟器验证待做) |
| `CYLTabBarItemSelectedTitle` | Optional title (NSString) shown while the tab is selected, like JD's "Home" tab that reads "Refresh" when it is selected; the tab shows `CYLTabBarItemTitle` again when another tab is selected. Works in every style (classic, Liquid Glass, FlatDesign). Pair it with `CYLTabBarItemSelectedImage` (or a Lottie animation, which replays on a re-tap) and with the reselect gesture (`cyl_tabBarItemGestureHandler`) to refresh on a second tap. It can be changed in place, like `CYLTabBarItemTitle`, with `-updateTabBarItemAtIndex:attributes:`. See docs/TabBarItem-Selected-Title.md. | `CYLTabBarItemAttributes.selectedTitle` (built; emulator check pending / 已编译，模拟器验证待做) |
| `CYLTabBarItemImage` | `CYLTabBarItemImage` / `CYLTabBarItemSelectedImage` (and the dark keys below) take an image name or a UIImage. A name is the prepared form, recommended for most cases: it is rendered as original (the icon keeps its colors) and its dark image is loaded for you. A UIImage is used as it is: an image from `imageNamed:` has the `Automatic` rendering mode, which a tab bar tints as a template, so icons turn into one-color silhouettes unless you call `imageWithRenderingMode:UIImageRenderingModeAlwaysOriginal` first. | `CYLTabBarItemAttributes.image` (built; emulator check pending / 已编译，模拟器验证待做) |

The tab then shows them where the interface style is dark (system setting or `overrideUserInterfaceStyle`) and switches by itself. Not needed when the image has a Dark appearance in the asset catalog or a "<name>_dark" image exists (`UIImage.cyl_darkImageNameSuffix`); when given, they replace those. | `CYLTabBarItemAttributes.darkImage` / `darkSelectedImage` (AppStorage `cyl_colorMode`) (built; emulator check pending / 已编译，模拟器验证待做) |

The downloaded images then replace them, in every style, also over a Lottie icon, through `-setTabBarItemIcon:selectedIcon:size:atIndex:`, drawn with their own colors, a GIF animating. Any source that method takes works too (a file path, a UIImage...). `CYLTabBarItemImageURLSize` (an NSValue of CGSize) sets their size, the placeholder's by default. They are cached in memory and in the sandbox, see `CYLImageCache` to set how long and how much. @{ CYLTabBarItemTitle : @"Home", CYLTabBarItemImage : @"home_normal", // default and placeholder CYLTabBarItemSelectedImage : @"home_selected", CYLTabBarItemImageURL : @"https://example.com/home.png", // replaces them once downloaded CYLTabBarItemSelectedImageURL : @"https://example.com/home_selected.png" } | `CYLTabBarItemAttributes.imageURL` / `selectedImageURL` (built; emulator check pending / 已编译，模拟器验证待做) |

| `CYLTabBarController` | Keys of a tab bar configuration: one dictionary that holds everything an initializer takes, for `-initWithConfiguration:`, and the same keys in a configuration file (JSON, YAML, plist...) or a downloaded one, see `CYLTabBarController (CYLConfiguration)`. In code the values have their usual types; in a file, strings work for every key (see each key). Missing keys take the defaults of the other initializers. - `CYLTabBarControllerViewControllers`: NSArray<UIViewController *> (code only), matched to the items by index. Without it, each tab's page comes from its page ID, see `CYLTabBarItemPageIdentifier`. - `CYLTabBarControllerTabBarItemsAttributes`: NSArray<NSDictionary *>, the item attributes (`CYLTabBarItemTitle`...). - `CYLTabBarControllerImageInsets`: NSValue of UIEdgeInsets, or "{top, left, bottom, right}", [t, l, b, r] or {top: , left: , bottom: , right: }. Default UIEdgeInsetsZero. - `CYLTabBarControllerTitlePositionAdjustment`: NSValue of UIOffset, or "{horizontal, vertical}", [h, v] or {horizontal: , vertical: }. Default UIOffsetZero. - `CYLTabBarControllerStyleType`: NSNumber of CYLTabBarStyleType, or "default", "system", "flatDesign", "liquidGlass". Default CYLTabBarStyleTypeDefault. - `CYLTabBarControllerContext`: NSString, see `context`. Default nil. - `CYLTabBarControllerPageRegistry`: CYLTabBarPageRegistry or any `CYLTabBarPageProviding` (code only), the page providers of this tab bar controller only, looked up before the shared registry. Lets several tab bars map one page ID to different pages. - `CYLTabBarControllerPageResolver`: CYLTabBarPageProvider block (code only), called for each tab whose page ID is not in `CYLTabBarControllerPageRegistry`, before the shared registry; return nil to go on looking. - `CYLTabBarControllerPageLookupOrder`: NSArray<CYLTabBarPageSource> (or a comma-separated string) of "instance", "resolver", "shared", "automatic": where pages are looked up, in order. Default all four, in that order. - `CYLTabBarControllerAutomaticPageRegistration`: NSNumber (BOOL), or "true" / "false"; NO leaves the classes that adopt `CYLTabBarPage` out of the lookup. On iOS 13+ UIKit ignores `-[UITabBarItem titlePositionAdjustment]` once the tab bar uses `UITabBarAppearance` (e.g. after `tabBar.standardAppearance = ...`), so the offset is also written into a copy of the tab bar's `standardAppearance` (and `scrollEdgeAppearance` on iOS 15+) installed on each tab with an offset. Changes the app makes to the tab bar's appearance later are picked up on the next layout. `UIOffsetZero` leaves the tabs untouched, so an offset set through the appearance proxy or `UITabBarAppearance` still applies (issue #583). Works for all tab bar styles: the classic system tab bar, Liquid Glass (iOS 26+) and FlatDesign. | `CYLTabBarController.titlePositionAdjustment` (@Prop) (built; emulator check pending / 已编译，模拟器验证待做) |
| `CYLTabBarController automaticallyAdjustsImageOnlyTabs` | Whether image-only tabs (tabs without a title) are adjusted automatically. Default is YES. When the first tab button has no title label, the classic tab bar measures once how far the image has to move to be vertically centered (`-[CYLTabBar tabImageViewDefaultOffset]`), then, for every tab whose item has no title, sets `imageInsets` to that offset and moves the empty title out of the way (`titlePositionAdjustment`). A value of the app is never replaced: tabs with a title, an item with its own `imageInsets` or `titlePositionAdjustment` (set on the item or with `CYLTabBarItemImageInsets` / `CYLTabBarItemTitlePositionAdjustment`), and a non-zero controller-level `imageInsets` / `titlePositionAdjustment` are left as they are. Set it to NO to turn the adjustment off and lay out the tabs yourself: the tab bar stops measuring, and the values it had already written are restored. Set it before the tab bar is laid out (in `-init…` or `-viewDidLoad`) to avoid seeing the icons move once. | `CYLTabBarController noNeedUIDesignCompatibility` | Setting NO means flat design. This property is the code alternative to the UI compatibility mode and only takes effect on iOS26+. Since the name of the UI compatibility mode is obscure, the more elegant and intuitive way is to set CYLTabBarStyleType, which internally sets this property to decide whether flat design is used. @return means CYLTabBarStyleType == CYLTabBarStyleTypeFlatDesign if return NO, means CYLTabBarStyleType == CYLTabBarStyleTypeLiquidGlass if return YES; @attention better switch to property CYLTabBarStyleType | TODO: partial on HarmonyOS: `CYLTabBarController.tabBarStyleType` = `CYLTabBarStyleType.FlatDesign` (the iOS 26 compatibility switch itself has no HarmonyOS meaning) (cyltabbar; built / 已实现) |
| `CYLTabBarController allowsVerticalBar` | Whether the system may show the bars in the vertical bar: a column on the leading or trailing edge that iOS 27.1 uses on some devices, such as the folded iPhone Duo. Defaults to NO. - NO: CYLTabBarController returns `UIVerticalBarBehaviorDisabled` from `preferredVerticalBarBehavior`, so the tab bar stays at the bottom and the status bar stays horizontal. Exception (issue #672): a screen that overrides `preferredVerticalBarBehavior` itself (the selected view controller, or the top view controller of a selected navigation controller) still decides for itself, e.g. return `UIVerticalBarBehaviorAutomatic` to opt in. - YES: the system default behaviour, as in 1.99.65 and earlier. `UITabBarController` passes the choice to the selected view controller, so each screen can still opt out by overriding `preferredVerticalBarBehavior`. This is a convenience switch for UIKit's `preferredVerticalBarBehavior`; a subclass may override that property directly instead. Changes apply immediately: the setter calls `setNeedsUpdateOfVerticalBarConfiguration`. Not related to `tabBarController.sidebar.preferredPlacement` / `sidebar.isAvailable` (iOS 27): those choose between the tab bar and an iPad-style sidebar when there is room for one (regular width) and need the `UITab` API; the vertical bar is used in compact width, where the sidebar is not available. Status with YES: Liquid Glass style verified on the iPhone Duo simulator (layout, Lottie icons, badges, plus button, re-tap, long press and drag). FlatDesign style verified on the iPhone Duo simulator: the status bar moves to the trailing column and the FlatDesign bar stays at the bottom with its items centered across the full width (see `CYLFlatDesignTabBar.respectsVerticalStatusBarSafeArea`). Folded iPhone Duo, FlatDesign, vertical status bar with centered items: tabBarController.allowsVerticalBar = YES; // respectsVerticalStatusBarSafeArea keeps its default NO No effect below iOS 27.1 or when built with an SDK older than iOS 27.1. | N/A on HarmonyOS: the vertical bar is an iOS 27.1 system feature of some devices / 不适用：竖向栏是 iOS 27.1 部分设备的系统特性 |

| `CYLTabBarController(CYLTabBarMinimize) cyl_tabBarMinimizeBehavior` | How the tab bar reacts when the current page scrolls. Default `CYLTabBarMinimizeBehaviorAutomatic`. - Liquid Glass on iOS 26+ (every style except FlatDesign): sets the native `UITabBarController.tabBarMinimizeBehavior`. The system shrinks the tab bar and picks the scroll view; choose it with `-[UIViewController setContentScrollView:forEdge:]` when a page has several. - FlatDesign: hides the tab bar with `-setTabBarHidden:animated:` when the selected page (the top page of a navigation controller) scrolls, and shows it again on the opposite scroll, when the page scrolls back to the top (OnScrollDown), and when another tab or page appears. A tab bar hidden by your own `-setTabBarHidden:` is left hidden. The scroll view is the page's `-contentScrollViewForEdge:NSDirectionalRectEdgeBottom`, otherwise the first scroll view in its view hierarchy. - Classic tab bar (every style except FlatDesign on iOS 25 and earlier, and on iOS 26 in UI compatibility mode): the system tab bar, with its plus button, is hidden with `-setTabBarHidden:animated:` when the selected page scrolls, and shown on the opposite scroll, at the top (OnScrollDown) and when another tab or page appears (animated by UIKit on iOS 18 and later, as FlatDesign before iOS 18). Pages pushed with `hidesBottomBarWhenPushed` are left to UIKit, and a tab bar at the top (not at the bottom) is never hidden. FlatDesign and the classic tab bar hide through the same public `-setTabBarHidden:animated:` you can call yourself; a tab bar you hid with it stays hidden. Can be set at any time, before or after the view loads. When it comes back (issue #13, as in the Facebook app): the bar hides only while the user drags down through content; it comes back at once, in every style, on background / foreground switches, a call, any system or in-app alert, a modal page, another key window, a push notification, a push or pop, and a memory warning, and hides again only on a new drag. Robust by design: a whitelist, not a list of events. The bar stays hidden only inside a hide session, started by the user scrolling down and bound to its context (page, tab, scroll view, window); anything else, also this controller's appear / disappear / size change and the keyboard, ends it and shows the bar. See docs/TabBar-Minimize-On-Scroll.md, "When the tab bar hides, and when it comes back". Same switch, Apple's API: on iOS 26+, `tabBarController.tabBarMinimizeBehavior = UITabBarMinimizeBehaviorOnScrollDown` does exactly the same in every style (CYLTabBarController overrides it; both read and write one value). Use this property where iOS 25 and earlier must be supported, since Apple's property does not exist there. | `CYLTabBarController.tabBarMinimizeBehavior` (@Prop) + `cyl_reportScroll(delta)` (built; emulator check pending / 已编译，模拟器验证待做) |
| `CYLTabBarController(CYLTabBarMinimize) cyl_hidesTabBarOnScroll` | The most direct switch: hide the tab bar while the page scrolls down, show it again when it scrolls back up. Named like UIKit's `hidesBarsOnSwipe` and `hidesBottomBarWhenPushed`, and the same feature as `cyl_tabBarMinimizeBehavior`, which it reads and writes: tabBarController.cyl_hidesTabBarOnScroll = YES; // == cyl_tabBarMinimizeBehavior = OnScrollDown tabBarController.cyl_hidesTabBarOnScroll = NO; // == cyl_tabBarMinimizeBehavior = Never What YES does in each style: - Liquid Glass (iOS 26+): calls Apple's own `UITabBarController.tabBarMinimizeBehavior = OnScrollDown`; the system minimizes the tab bar. - FlatDesign: the flat tab bar is hidden and shown with `-setTabBarHidden:animated:` while the page scrolls. - Classic tab bar (iOS 25 and earlier, e.g. iOS 17, and iOS 26 in UI compatibility mode): the system tab bar is hidden and shown with `-setTabBarHidden:animated:`, with FlatDesign's animation before iOS 18. The getter is YES while scroll hiding is on in either direction (OnScrollDown or OnScrollUp). Use `cyl_tabBarMinimizeBehavior` for OnScrollUp or Automatic. | `CYLTabBarController.hidesTabBarOnScroll` (@Prop) (built; emulator check pending / 已编译，模拟器验证待做) |

| `CYLTabBarHostBadgeValue` | A view that shows only the tab bar of a CYLTabBarController made from a configuration (`+[CYLTabBarController tabBarControllerWithConfiguration:]`, see docs/Configuration-File.md). The pages belong to someone else: React Native, Flutter, or an app that draws its own content. Every tab gets a transparent, empty page. The React Native and Flutter components of `CrossPlatform/` are thin wrappers around it. - The tab bar controller is built once the view is in a window with a real width (a bar laid out at width 0 keeps its titles cut), and added as a child of the nearest view controller. - Image values given as URL strings (a file, or a dev server) are loaded on a background queue first, then the tab bar is built on the main queue; `imageResolver` handles other values (e.g. a Flutter asset). - Each view uses its own `CYLTabBarControllerContext` unless the configuration gives one, so several can be on screen. - Indexes (`selectedIndex`, `badgeValues`, `didSelectTab`) count the tabs of the configuration; the plus button is left out. CYLTabBarHostView *bar = [[CYLTabBarHostView alloc] init]; bar.didSelectTab = ^(NSInteger index, NSString *identifier) { [self showPageAtIndex:index]; }; bar.configuration = @{ CYLTabBarControllerTabBarItemsAttributes : items }; | `CYLBadge.cyl_showBadgeValue(value)` on `CYLTabBarController.badges[index]` (built; emulator check pending / 已编译，模拟器验证待做) |

### `CYLTabBarItemAnimation/PAG/CYLPAGTabBarItemAnimator.h`

| iOS 公开 API / iOS public API | 接口注释 / Comment | 鸿蒙对应接口 / HarmonyOS API |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `CYLTabBarPAGURL` | Keys for a tab's PAG animation, used exactly like their Lottie twins and through the same pipeline: the view is added in place of the tab's icon, plays when the tab is selected, stops when another one is, follows `lottieAnimationViewContentMode`, is returned by `-[UIControl cyl_lottieAnimationView]` and posts `CYLTabBarItemAnimationViewDidAddNotification`. | `CYLTabBarPageRegistry` | A map from page IDs to page providers: a configuration (file, URL or dictionary) names each tab's page by a cross-platform string ID, and the app registers what that ID creates, so iOS and Android share one configuration. - `+sharedRegistry` is the global registry, used by every tab bar controller (like React Native's `AppRegistry`). - A registry you create is used by one tab bar controller only: pass it as `CYLTabBarControllerPageRegistry`. ### `CYLUtils/CYLResourceRoute.h`

| iOS 公开 API / iOS public API | 接口注释 / Comment | 鸿蒙对应接口 / HarmonyOS API |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `CYLResourceRoute` | Resource routes: one string that says where a resource is (a configuration file, a folder of string tables…), built into the app or in its sandbox (e.g. downloaded at run time), the same on iOS, Android, React Native and Flutter (docs/Resource-Routes.md). The prefix decides, in this order: bundle:<path> the app's resources (Android: assets) sandbox:Documents/<path> Documents (Android: filesDir) sandbox:Caches/<path> Library/Caches (Android: cacheDir); sandbox:tmp/<path> the temporary folder sandbox:<path> below the app's home folder (Android: the app's data folder) file:///<path> a local file URL /<path> an absolute path ~/<path> the app's home folder <path> relative to `baseDirectory` (a configuration file's folder), else the app's resources A query picks one file in that folder: `name`, and optionally `theme`, `version` and `format`, for files named `{name}[-{theme}][@{version}].{format}`. Without `version` the highest one wins; without `format` any format the configuration parser reads, preferring JSON, YAML, plist, XML, TOML, then the others: sandbox:Caches/tabbar?name=tabbar&theme=dark&version=2.1&format=json → …/Caches/tabbar/tabbar-dark@2.1.json bundle:Configurations?name=tabbar → the highest tabbar[@version].{json,…} The library never ships these resources: string tables and configuration files belong to the app. | TODO: no public resource route resolver; only `CYLTabBarManifest.manifestWithRoute(context, route)` resolves a rawfile or absolute sandbox route internally / 待做：没有公开的资源路由解析类；目前只有 `CYLTabBarManifest.manifestWithRoute(context, route)` 在内部解析 rawfile 路径或沙箱绝对路径 |
| `CYLResourceRoute +pathForRoute:baseDirectory:` | — | TODO: no public resource route resolver; only `CYLTabBarManifest.manifestWithRoute(context, route)` resolves a rawfile or absolute sandbox route internally / 待做：没有公开的资源路由解析类；目前只有 `CYLTabBarManifest.manifestWithRoute(context, route)` 在内部解析 rawfile 路径或沙箱绝对路径 |
| `CYLResourceRoute +pathOfFileInDirectory:name:theme:version:format:` | — | TODO: no public lookup of a file by name / theme / version / format in a directory (`CYLTabBarManifest.pathOfAssetWithKey(key, theme, state)` covers manifest assets only) / 待做：没有按名称 / 主题 / 版本 / 格式在目录中查找文件的公开方法（`CYLTabBarManifest.pathOfAssetWithKey` 只覆盖清单资源） |

### `UIViewController+CYLSettingsSection.h`

| iOS 公开 API / iOS public API | 接口注释 / Comment | 鸿蒙对应接口 / HarmonyOS API |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `CYLSettingsSection` | Section index of the settings rows at the top of a list: row 0 is the language setting (`-cyl_languageCellForTableView:`), row 1 the memory warning check (`-cyl_memoryWarningCellForTableView:`), row 2 switches the title offset of all tabs (`CYLTabBarController.titlePositionAdjustment`, issue #475), row 3 switches `tabBar.standardAppearance` themes, shared by Liquid Glass and FlatDesign, row 4 toggles the cached login state (`cyl_loggedIn`) and names the tabs that need login (issue #19), row 5 shows the plus button's touchable area and scales it with a slider (issue #91), row 6 selects the next tab by its index without the plus button (`cyl_selectedIndexIgnoringPlusButton`, issue #515), row 7 switches how the tab bar minimizes or hides on scroll (`cyl_tabBarMinimizeBehavior`, issue #13), row 8 switches the tap animation of the tabs, row 9 turns on the long press of the tabs, row 10 turns on swiping to switch tabs, row 11 shows a subview that responds outside its superview, row 12 loads an image from a bundle, row 13 hides the navigation bar without a base class, row 14 opens the slide transition demo, row 15 switches the tap sound and haptic, row 16 switches the long press duration and double tap interval, row 17 switches to the previous or next tab, row 18 runs the CYLUtils weak associated object and nearest control helpers (issue #535), row 19 pushes a tab bar controller whose plus button gets its image later (loaded, replaced, removed, or a background image), row 20 picks a skin (theme) of the tab bar (`CYLThemeManager`, `CYLTabBarTheme`, issue #216), row 21 lists the scroll hiding simulations in an action sheet (`-cyl_presentScrollHideSimulationMenu`, issue #13), row 22 creates a tab bar controller from a configuration file or URL (`UIViewController+CYLConfigurationDemo.h`), then the simulated failures of configurations, one row each (`-cyl_configurationEdgeCaseCellForTableView:row:`), then the in-place tab item updates (`-cyl_tabBarItemUpdateCellForTableView:row:`): title, icon, network icon, all network icons, all local icons, GIF icon, all titles, replace neighboring tabs. | `DemoRow` / `DemoSection` settings rows in entry `pages/Index.ets` (language, memory warning, title offset, appearance… rows; example only, not Works for every animation library: Lottie 4 (a color value provider), GIF (template frames), PAG / SVGA / Lottie 2 (a sourceAtop overlay), Rive (the library's own method); `CYLAnimatedItemView.animationTint` overrides it. | `CYLTabBarAnimationOptionTint` ("tint"; `CYLTabBarAnimationTintTitle` = the icon color) (built; emulator check pending / 已编译，模拟器验证待做) |

Not needed with tint @"title", which follows the tab bar's (dynamic) tints already. Works for every animation library, like the tint; `CYLAnimatedItemView.animationDarkTint` overrides it. | `CYLTabBarAnimationOptionDarkTint` ("darkTint", used in dark mode) (built; emulator check pending / 已编译，模拟器验证待做) |

| `CYLAnimatedItemView` | An animated icon + title control to subclass, shared by the tags of CollectionViewClassifyMenu and CYLSearchViewController, the placeholders of CYLTableViewPlaceHolder and the tab buttons of CYLTabBarController: - an icon (`imageView`) that plays any file of the animation engine (`animationURL`), its static `image` / `selectedImage` shown until the animation is ready; - a title (`titleLabel`), beside the icon or under it (`axis`); - an optional accessory icon (`accessoryView`, e.g. a delete cross) with its own tap, placed before, after or on the icon's top trailing corner; - gestures on the whole control, reported to `delegate`: tap, long press and drag (`isDragEnabled`). Subclasses change what they need: the content (`CYLAnimatedItemContent`), the layout (`layoutContent(in:)`, `contentSizeThatFits(_:)`), the appearance per state (`itemStateDidChange()`), the accessibility text (`itemAccessibilityLabel()`), more gestures (add recognizers), or the animation source (`animationSource`). It is the CYLAnimatedItem pod and module (`import CYLAnimatedItem`; SwiftPM: `import CYLAnimatedItemViews`), which depends on no other pod, not on CYLTabBarController, and plays animations only when the engine is in the build (the Swift condition `CYL_ANIMATION_ENGINE_AVAILABLE`, set by the `Engine` subspec); static images otherwise. Written in Swift (2026-11-19, docs/Swift-Migration.md step 60) with the same Objective-C API: `@import CYLAnimatedItem;`. | `CYLAnimatedItemView` (ArkUI `@Component` struct, configured by props and callbacks instead of subclassing) (built; emulator check pending / 已编译，模拟器验证待做) |

Hidden from accessibility (the control reads as one element). | N/A on HarmonyOS: the component draws its own `Image` / `SymbolGlyph` and does not expose it, as ArkUI composes views declaratively; style it with `iconSize` / `iconColor` / 不适用：组件自己绘制内部的 `Image` / `SymbolGlyph`，不对外暴露；通过 `iconSize` / `iconColor` 设置样式 |
